events.dorry-vs-brogy: The hundred-year duel between the giants Dorry and Brogy, warriors of Elbaph.
events.dorry-beer-sabotage: Baroque Works plants a bomb in Dorry's beer and taints the sacred duel.
events.candle-champion-trap: Mr. 3 traps Zoro, Nami and Vivi in his wax cake; Zoro considers cutting off his own legs.
events.usopp-kaenboshi-candle-escape: Usopp sets the wax setup on fire with his Kaenboshi and frees his crewmates; Luffy defeats Mr. 3.
events.brogy-dorry-elbaf-spear: The giants split the Sea King blocking the route with the Elbaph Spear technique.
events.nami-falls-ill: Nami falls seriously ill, forcing the crew to search for a doctor.
